data.name: Yograj
data.gender_notes: Yograj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yograj means 'God of Yoga'. Yoga is a practice of mindfulness, meditation, and physical postures to attain spiritual growth. This name signifies the power and strength one gains through the practice of yoga and the wisdom it brings, leading to a joyful and fulfilling life. The name Yograj carries the meaning “God of Yoga” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yograj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of yoga and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yograj is a divine name signifying the supreme power that guides one on the path of yoga and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Yograj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Yoga.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yograj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yograj carries deep cultural significance in Hinduism. Yoga, originating in India almost 5,000 years ago, is an integral part of Indian culture and is globally recognized as a path to mental, emotional, and physical well-being. A Yograj, as the god of Yoga, represents the power and influence yoga has had and continues to have on Indian culture and its people.
data.spiritual_significance: Yograj is a name rich in spiritual meaning. It signifies the divine power and wisdom that comes from the practice of yoga. Through yoga, we create a connection between body, mind, and spirit. Yoga helps us cultivate self-awareness, self-discipline, and self-realization, leading us to inner peace, contentment, and a greater connection to the divine. Yograj, as a divine being, embodies these qualities and represents the ultimate goal of the yoga practice.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yograj: The Divine Sovereign of Yoga. One who rules and guides the spiritual journey, bestowing grace and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Yograj was an epithet given to Bhagiratha, a legendary king of the Solar Dynasty (Suryavansha) who is believed to have brought the River Goddess Ganga to the earth from the heavens.
Yograj is also the name of the father of the esteemed poet Sant Tukaram, who lived during the 17th century in Maharashtra, India.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Yograj' has modern relevance in various contexts, primarily in the fields of Astrology, Spirituality, and Bollywood. Yograj is a name of reverence and is believed to be associated with spiritual power and divine guidance in Astrology. Many astrologers and spiritual gurus use this name to build an authentic and trustworthy brand. On Instagram, several accounts (#yograjastrologer, #yograjspirituality) are dedicated to providing daily horoscopes, astrological predictions, and spiritual guidance to followers. On Twitter, there are numerous accounts of Yograj Sikand, a renowned astrologer, who frequently shares his predictions and insights, gaining a massive following. Additionally, on YouTube, channels like 'Yograj Gurubhai' and 'Yograj Astrology' provide comprehensive astrological consultations, horoscope analysis, and spiritual guidance in the form of videos, which are widely popular and accessible to a global audience.

name_in_real_life.story: Maya Yograj, a teacher in Kathmandu, Nepal, shares that their name Yograj meaning "God of Yoga" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
